evidence.title: ’63 Falcon And ’14 Mustang GT Merge To Create The Falcon GT
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Coyote never caught that crafty bird and suffered accordingly. [e002:f02] But no one ever asked what would happen if the Coyote and a Falcon got together. [e002:f03] Florida’s Dean Varnadore, a sheetmetal fabricator and craftsman, did exactly that: He took a wrecked 2014 Mustang GT, cut everything out, grabbed the engine and six-speed manual gearbox, and combined it with a ‘63 Falcon Sprint. [e002:f04] Dean sliced, diced, and julienned the floor of the modern ponycar and meticulously fashioned it into the Falcon. [e002:f05] Everything, including the steering wheel, instrument panel, seats and electronics, now calls the ’60’s compact home. [e002:f06] The side-exiting pipes are the cutouts. (Photo by Jim Campisano) He fabricated his own frame and front and rear suspensions, dropped in the S197 Mustang’s drivetrain, and then went to work on the body. [e002:f07] This proves that had the Coyote and Falcon joined forces in the ’60s, that Road Runner would have been in a heap of trouble. [e002:f08] I cut the body off the Falcon and built a full square tube frame with a roll cage,” Dean said. [e002:f09] “I put the floor pan off the Mustang in there, and then I was able to use the Mustang dash, everything out of the new Mustang, and we’re just using the body off the Falcon pretty much, but it’s all full-frame car on coilovers.” Custom Forgeline wheels measure 18×12 in the rear and are wrapped in 305/35 Nitto 555G2s. [e002:f10] I’d rather build it than try to make it back to stock,” said the owner of Dean’s Custom Sheet Metal in Plant City, Florida. [e002:f11] “I took a Granada spindle, and cut the spindle off of it, and got the spindle off of the Mustang’s MacPherson strut. [e002:f12] Except for the tune and an upgraded exhaust system, the ’14 5.0 Coyote is stock. [e002:f13] Oh, and the Falcon script under the hood and in the interior lights up. (Photos by Jim Campisano) “I never measured the wheelbase of either car. [e002:f14] He did have to notch the doors to fit the dash in there, but that was about it. (Photo by Jim Campisano) The 2014 Mustang GT 5.0 made 420 net horsepower and 390 lb.-ft. of torque. [e002:f15] I built this whole car in exactly one year.’ Tubs were required to hold the 18×12-inch wheels and 305-series tires. (Photo by Jim Campisano) Dean said it is a comfortable car to drive and it handles like Mustang — only better. [e002:f16] That’s 318 turns in 11 miles one-way, race fans. ”It echoed off them mountains pretty good,” Dean boasted. (Photos by Jim Campisano) The Falcon, Ford’s original import-fighting compact car, was a fine piece of economical transportation, but it never competed in the performance arena.

evidence.title: Congress is investigating whether Starlink powered Myanmar's scam compounds
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Starlink wasn't licensed in Myanmar and had no traffic there before February, then became the country's top internet provider for three straight months Satellite dishes meant to connect remote villages ended up on the roofs of fraud factories instead. [e003:f02] The US Congress Joint Economic Committee has opened a bipartisan investigation into whether SpaceX's Starlink knowingly supplied internet access to scam compounds in Myanmar, operations the United Nations says run on forced labor and human trafficking. [e003:f03] The numbers behind the investigation are what make it hard to wave away. [e003:f04] Starlink wasn't even licensed in Myanmar and didn't register enough traffic to make the country's internet provider rankings before a February crackdown by Thai, Chinese and Myanmar authorities that repatriated thousands of suspected scammers. [e003:f05] An AFP investigation found exactly where those dishes went: on the rooftops of compounds like KK Park, a notorious scam center on the Myanmar-Thailand border. [e003:f06] When Myanmar's junta raided KK Park on October 20, state media reported soldiers seized "30 sets of Starlink receivers and accessories." AFP's own images from the same raid showed nearly 80 dishes on the roof of a single building. [e003:f07] Senator Maggie Hassan, a Democrat on the Joint Economic Committee, sent Musk a letter in July asking SpaceX eleven direct questions about Starlink's role in the scam economy. [e003:f08] Hassan has since publicly urged Musk to block Starlink access for the criminal networks running compounds across Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia and Laos, arguing that Starlink's appeal to these operations is precisely its design: it works independently of national telecom infrastructure, it's decentralized, and it's portable enough to relocate when authorities close in. [e003:f09] The Pentagon cleared Starlink from America's router blacklist while every other foreign-made device gets shut out The FCC exempted SpaceX Starlink routers from its national security router blacklist on July 20, 2026, after the Department of Defense granted conditional approval. [e003:f10] According to the US Treasury Department, Americans lost an estimated $10 billion to Southeast Asian scam networks last year, a 66% jump in twelve months. [e003:f11] The UN's human rights office has separately estimated that at least 120,000 people in Myanmar and roughly 100,000 in Cambodia may be trapped inside these operations, held in fortified compounds and subjected to torture, sexual abuse, forced abortions and solitary confinement. [e003:f12] In October, Lauren Dreyer, SpaceX's vice president of business operations for Starlink, posted on X that the company had "proactively identified and disabled over 2,500 Starlink Kits in the vicinity of suspected 'scam centers'" in Myanmar. [e003:f13] Here's the thing about that 2,500 figure: it's real, and it's also not nearly enough to explain how Starlink became Myanmar's top provider for three straight months. [e003:f14] Starlink is a critical infrastructure company with enormous government contracts, from Pentagon satellite deals to rural broadband subsidies, and its legitimacy rests on being seen as a neutral utility, not a utility that fraud syndicates can simply order online. evidence.title: Falcon Capital Takes Strategic Stake In Energy Investor Pont Capital
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The investment will make Falcon Capital a strategic shareholder in Pont. [e004:f02] Falcon Capital is part of the Falcon Family Office Group and is positioning the investment as a way to gain additional exposure to structural changes affecting global energy markets. [e004:f03] Pont Capital invests across both private and public markets. [e004:f04] Its focus areas include conventional energy, low-carbon electricity generation, sustainable infrastructure, and critical minerals. [e004:f05] These sectors are increasingly intersecting as electricity consumption expands and global governments and corporations prioritize energy security, electrification, industrial reshoring, and data center development. [e004:f06] Falcon said the investment gives it a position alongside a specialist investment team focused on energy and resources as demand for capital across those markets increases. [e004:f07] The companies are also positioning the partnership around Falcon Family Office Group’s broader strategy of connecting investment opportunities across Western and Eastern markets. [e004:f08] Pont’s investment mandate covers resources expected to play an important role in the next phase of global industrial development. [e004:f09] Traditional energy remains part of that strategy as supply security becomes more important, while low-carbon generation and sustainable infrastructure are attracting increasing amounts of capital. [e004:f10] Critical minerals are another central component as battery production, renewable energy, advanced manufacturing, defense technologies, and digital infrastructure increase demand for specialized raw materials. [e004:f11] Falcon described the current environment as the beginning of a new energy supercycle. [e004:f12] The firm sees rising power consumption from electrification and data centers combining with limited supplies of certain energy resources and minerals to create long-duration investment opportunities. [e004:f13] The strategic stake provides Falcon with direct exposure to Pont’s sector expertise and investment pipeline as these trends develop. evidence.title: Stock markets: navigating quarterly results, US GDP and the ECB. Milan (+0.4 per cent) regains the 50,000 mark – Alphabet and Microsoft’s results
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Interest rates remain unchanged for the Fed and the ECB, whilst Lagarde announces her departure. [e002:f02] Oil and gas markets cool off (Il Sole 24 Ore Radiocor) - Despite a few tricky bends, the European stock markets found the right trajectory and crossed the finish line higher. [e002:f03] It had, after all, been a frenzied day on the financial markets, with mixed quarterly results, better-than-expected US GDP figures and the ECB’s interest rate decision – preceded, moreover, by the announcement of Christine Lagarde’s departure . [e002:f04] Against this backdrop, optimism prevailed on the European stock markets, with Milan (+0.36%) managing to claw back the 50,000-point mark by a whisker (to 50,002), thanks to a surge in Prysmian (+6.6%). [e002:f05] The same cannot be said for Wall Street, which closed in negative territory: the Dow Jones lost 0.25 per cent to 52,342.56 points, the Nasdaq fell by 1.38 per cent to 26,184.73 points, whilst the S&P 500 fell by 0.31 per cent to 7,720.38 points. [e002:f06] Yesterday, the Federal Reserve also left interest rates unchanged, as expected: the US economy is solid and the only concern is inflation, according to central bankers, who today monitored the PCE inflation figure, which stood at 3.6% in September, below forecasts. [e002:f07] By contrast, the US GDP figure came in higher than expected, at 3.4 per cent in the preliminary reading . [e002:f08] Banco BPM (-0.3%) and Intesa Sanpaolo (-0.4%) remain just below par, whilst MPS (+0.2%) – facing its annual general meeting today – and Mediobanca (-0.1%) closed close to par. [e002:f09] According to a report in Il Sole 24 Ore , the contribution required from the financial sector to fund the forthcoming Budget Law is set to rise to 5.5–6 billion euros , exceeding initial expectations, against a backdrop of measures adopted without prior agreement , as also reported by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. [e002:f10] The possibility of a merger with Mediobanca was also ruled out. [e002:f11] On the Milan Stock Exchange, Campari suffered a sharp fall (-6.6 per cent, having also been suspended at the start of trading) following the release of its quarterly results. [e002:f12] The defence sector also performed well, with Leonardo (+3.9%) and Fincantieri (+1.9%). [e002:f13] Despite the high tensions in the Middle East and Trump’s inflammatory statements, yet another attempt at negotiations by US Vice-President Vance – who has been in contact with senior Iranian official Mohsen Rezei – is helping to bring down oil and gas prices, with Brent trading around $113 , WTI at around $101 per barrel and TTF gas falling to 98 euros per MWh in Amsterdam. [e002:f14] In the foreign exchange market, the US dollar has seen little movement following the Fed’s announcement, with the euro continuing to trade below $1.12, reflecting rate decisions by the Fed and the ECB that had already been priced in by market participants.﻿ The spread between BTp and Bund bonds closed lower. [e002:f15] At the end of the day, the yield spread between the benchmark 10-year BTp and its German counterpart stood at 114 basis points, down 2 basis points on yesterday’s close. [e002:f16] The yield on the benchmark 10-year BTp also fell, closing at 4.49 per cent , down from 4.54 per cent the previous day.

evidence.title: 東証続伸、705円高 好決算で半導体銘柄に買い 前日の米株高も好材料
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 終値は前日比705円28銭高の6万4659円47銭で、約1週間ぶりに6万4000円を回復した。 [e008:f02] 好決算を発表した半導体関連銘柄を中心に買い注文が優勢となった。 [e008:f03] 東証株価指数（TOPIX）は11.57ポイント高の4003.28。 [e008:f04] 前日に半導体検査装置大手のアドバンテストが通期業績見通しの上方修正を発表し、買いを集めた。 [e008:f05] 好業績への期待からほかの人工知能（AI）や半導体関連銘柄も上昇し、相場を押し上げた。 [e008:f06] 米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が市場の想定通り政策金利を据え置いたことも安心感につながった。 [e008:f07] 前日の米国株式市場はハイテク関連を中心に値上がりし、東京市場も流れを引き継いだ。 [e008:f08] Google検索で「産経ニュース」を優先表示。 [e008:f09] ワンクリックで簡単登録 ジャンル ： 経済 金融・財政。

evidence.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（30日）円3日続伸、株急落 利回り低下
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 日銀が政策金利を据え置き、物価見通しを引き上げたことが材料となったほか、米国債利回りの低下もドルの重しとなった。 [e003:f02] 日銀は３０日、金融政策決定会合で金利の据え置きを決定した。 [e003:f03] ハイテク関連株の急落で人工知能（ＡＩ）投資への懸念が強まり、安全資産である米国債に資金が流入した。 [e003:f04] 米１０年債利回りは終盤で６．４ｂｐ低下の４．９２５％。 [e003:f05] ３０年債利回りは１．９ｂｐ低下の５．３１％で、月間低下幅は同じく２３年１２月以来の大きさとなる見通し。 [e003:f06] ＦＲＢの政策金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは８．１ｂｐ低下の４．５７５％。 [e003:f07] 物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４６１％。 [e003:f08] 米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ] ＜株式＞ 急落して取引を終えた。 [e003:f09] ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。 [e003:f10] アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 [e003:f11] フィラデルフィア半導体​指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。 [e003:f12] アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企⁠業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。 [e003:f13] 暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、⁠ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 [e003:f14] 月間ではブレントが１３．６％、ＷＴＩが１５．２％それぞれ上昇した。 [e003:f15] ヘッドライン 国内株式市場見通し：米中間選挙後は中東情勢悪化リスクも残り、来週は様子見姿勢強めたい 14:23 フィスコ 今週の【早わかり株式市況】3週ぶり反発、半導体に買い戻しも週末に一転売り優勢 6:40 株探ニュース 新興市場見通し：金利上昇一服で成長株買い直し、生成AI関連以外の銘柄を選好 14:22 フィスコ 富田隆弥の【CHART CLUB】 11月相場も乱高下か 10:00 株探ニュース NY市場概況－ダウ 572.25ドル安と続落 AI・ハイテク株が急落 7:11 トレーダーズ・ウェブ 米CFTC委員長、暗号資産市場の規制必要性を強調──バイナンス流出受け 16:10 NADA NEWS 米ドル/円は157～158円台のレンジ相場が続くか。 [e003:f16] 13:00 東洋経済オンライン もっと見る マーケット指標 日経平均株価 63,290.11 -1,369.36 NYダウ 51,770.31 -572.25 アメリカ ドル / 日本 円 157.5200 世界の指数 FX・為替情報 日本株ランキング 値上がり率 1 ウェッジＨ +30.00 % 2 ハリマ化Ｇ +28.44 % 3 アサヒ衛Ｈ +27.93 % もっと見る 値下がり率 1 ＪエスコＨ -26.45 % 2 栗田工 -20.99 % 3 菊水ＨＬＤ -18.60 % もっと見る。
